response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in production routing or navigation systems, and his work with DLang and Node.js doesn't clearly align with the core requirement of high-performance C++ routing tile pipelines.
strengths: Proven geospatial project experience with GISCollective and Open Green Map
Strong track record in distributed systems and low-latency data pipelines
Demonstrated ability to learn and contribute across diverse tech stacks
concerns: No visible commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing or map tile systems
Primary recent work is in TypeScript/Node.js, not the required C++ core
Lack of explicit experience with fault tolerance, consistency, or navigation data freshness at scale
